reason: Both identify the same location and root cause: refreshBufferSeconds for Garmin set to 6000 instead of 600. Both describe the same runtime consequence — tokens with roughly 10–100 minutes remaining are unnecessarily refreshed because the proactive refresh window is 10x too wide. The reviewer's mention of the boundary test (601 seconds triggering refresh) is a corroborating detail of the same mechanism, not a different bug.
